subject: cult-info-b
title: CULT.INFO.B.------SOC.RT.DY.
description: Diagram in AE(PD)-29 (Aspect Essence / Perception Dynamics, Level One), first of two on book p141, paired with v2-p141-2. Accompanies Braxton's developing concept of unification: 'the concept of unification has to do with an expanded awareness of what is happening on this planet — in this experience (life) — during this particular time period.' (C)CULT-INFO-B (the concept of culture-information basis) is crossed with SOC-RT-DY (social-reality dynamics): the question is what culture-information-basis produces when crossed with social-reality-dynamics — culture-information-basis being the substrate Braxton wants unification to operate over. TRS (transference) and RT-OP (reality operation) form the upper-right output. EXP-DY (experimental dynamics) anchors the right margin. PROG-SIGN (progressional significance) feeds in from below-left. PHY-U-P (physical universe particulars) anchors the lower-left. SOC-RT-DY itself sits centrally. TF-SH (transfer shift) hangs on the lower-right. (D)PART (the determining of participation) sits on the lower-center via a *dashed* edge to INFO-AF-B (information-affinity basis). Structural argument: culture-information-basis crossed with social-reality-dynamics is fed by progressional-significance plus physical-universe-particulars as lower upstreams, producing transference and reality-operation as upper outputs and transfer-shift as marginal output. The (d) prefix on PART is unusual and load-bearing — participation here is functioning as a *determining* relation (determines the ___ of its ___), and its link to information-affinity-basis is dashed (conditional). The diagram exposes Braxton's structural commitment for unification: it must be built on culture-information-basis as conceptual substrate, with reality-operation and transference as outputs, but the link from determining-participation to information-affinity-basis must be *worked* — it does not obtain automatically.
